basis: P-08, with explicit lexical, evidence and operating boundaries

codeIndex.identifiers: Python tokenize.NAME tokens, excluding the frozen reserved words before splitting
codeIndex.firstIdentifierSpan: earliest source line, then column, then original token text
codeIndex.filenameOnlyEvidence: exact version path field; never invent a source-line match
codeIndex.parseFailure: partial scope with affected path and reason; never complete no-match

tokenization.unicodeLimitation: Non-ASCII identifier semantics are not analyzed; disclose this limitation

documentation.processing: literal lines of strict UTF-8 text, including raw Markdown and fenced examples
documentation.explicitPaths: case-sensitive repository-relative .py paths that exactly match selected inventory entries
documentation.unresolvedPath: retain path, document line and reason; do not fabricate a code endpoint

rules: at least one retained token shared with the code index
matching.aggregation: one candidate per directed document/code pair at exact selected endpoint versions; retain distinct rule/token/line evidence
matching.ordering: document path, code path, document line, rule, token, code line and column
matching.requiredEvidence: exact document line plus matching code identifier span or exact path-field evidence
matching.confirmation: always requires a separate authorized human judgment
matching.manualCapture: separate origin and results; cannot repair an automatic miss

limits.exceededLimit: explicit partial/failed scope with named limit; no silent truncation or complete no-impact result

independentExpectation.expected: unconfirmed automatic lexical candidate with exact-version evidence
independentExpectation.additionalCandidates: retain and disclose; do not tune them away to satisfy the example
independentExpectation.status: conditional on acceptance before execution; no engine run has occurred

limitations: Lexical overlap proposes candidates; it does not establish semantic correctness.
File-level matching does not extract or resolve a full semantic program graph.
Raw templates are not rendered and external documentation is not fetched.
The declared sample is not complete Healthchecks project coverage.
Operating defaults are engineering choices, not measured performance results.
